items.title: AI Helped Hospital Lower Readmissions, Deaths After Discharge
items.excerpt: Houston Methodist used HDAI predictive AI (trained on Medicare data) to target post-discharge follow-up for its highest-risk Medicare surgical patients; 30-day post-discharge mortality fell ~35% and readmissions ~18% with no added staff, per an HLTH case study.

items.title: AI can analyze X-rays and CT scans to draft radiology reports. Will it make care better, safer?
items.excerpt: Ahead of RSNA 2026 in Chicago, STAT examines AI tools that draft radiology reports from X-rays and CT scans and the open question of whether draft reporting improves care and safety.

items.title: AI-assisted chest CT scan analysis of body composition at ICU admission and 6-month mortality
items.excerpt: Secondary analysis of a single-center prospective cohort of 509 ICU patients: automated AI body-composition analysis of admission chest CT, a measure rarely taken manually, was linked to 6-month survival.

items.title: Challenges in AI based tumor board case summarization and recommendations
items.excerpt: Researchers formally define tumor-board case summarization, treatment-option generation and meeting-outcome prediction as AI tasks and test them on tumor board datasets, mapping where current models fall short.

items.title: Artificial intelligence model for pancreatic cancer risk prediction in patients with pancreatic cystic lesions
items.excerpt: A developed and validated AI model stratifies pancreatic cancer risk in patients with pancreatic cystic lesions, aiming to replace complex, limited-accuracy existing approaches to cyst management.

items.title: Thyroid ultrasound AI yields high agreement with radiologists
items.excerpt: RSNA 2026 preview: a large real-world deployment of See-Mode thyroid ultrasound AI across 297 U.S. clinics prospectively measured how often radiologists kept the AI-generated TI-RADS descriptors.

items.title: GEHC adds AI layer to InteleOrchestrator
items.excerpt: GE HealthCare's Intelerad unit introduces InteleOrchestrator Clarity, an AI layer that gives radiologists source-linked summaries of prior reports and drafts structured reports from dictation for review.

items.title: Modular phantom tests AI on ovarian mass ultrasound
items.excerpt: RSNA 2026 preview: University of Twente researchers built an O-RADS-based transvaginal ultrasound phantom to enable controlled testing of computer-aided diagnosis software for ovarian masses.

items.title: FDA-Authorized AI/ML Tool for Sepsis Prediction: Development and Validation
items.excerpt: NEJM AI paper describing the development and validation of an FDA-authorized AI/ML tool for sepsis prediction (Crossref created 2026-11-19; body not retrievable - verify details).

items.title: 뷰노 '펀더스 AI' 브라질 상륙, K-의료AI 남미 영토 확장 본격화
items.excerpt: 뷰노가 브라질 국가위생감시국(ANVISA)으로부터 안저영상 판독 보조 AI 'VUNO Med-Fundus AI' 의료기기 인허가를 받아 현지 출시한다. 알베르트 아인슈타인 병원이 현지 검증을 수행했다.

items.title: 의사·약사·간호사 등 국가시험 AI 활용 부정행위 대응법 추진
items.excerpt: 생성형 AI·스마트안경을 활용한 시험 부정행위에 대응해 이만희 복지위원장이 의료인 국가시험 부정행위 응시 제한을 최대 3회에서 5회로 늘리는 의료법·약사법·간호법 개정안을 대표발의했다.

items.title: 심평원, AI 활용 '고가약 사전 심사 기간 단축' 추진
items.excerpt: 건강보험심사평가원이 AI로 급여 인정 가능성이 높은 고가약 사전심사 사례를 선별해 대기시간을 줄이고, 청구 데이터로 희귀질환 의심 환자를 찾는 파운데이션 모델도 검토한다. 적용 시점은 미정.

items.title: '책임' 대신 '판단' 택한 의학한림원…"AI 책임은 함께 나눠야"
items.excerpt: 대한민국의학한림원이 의료 AI 활용 윤리 가이드라인 초안을 공개했다. 진단·치료의 최종 판단은 의료진에게 있다고 명시했지만 AI 사고 시 개발사·병원·의료진 간 책임 배분은 과제로 남았다.

items.title: 측정부터 리포트까지 AI가…삼진제약, 심장초음파 솔루션 론칭
items.excerpt: 삼진제약과 온택트헬스가 영상 자동 분류·최적 영상 선택·자동 측정·스트레인 분석과 전문의 감수 리포트를 제공하는 심장초음파 AI 분석 솔루션 'SoniX EchoPilot'을 론칭했다.

items.title: Innovaccer integrates Grok Voice into Gravity Voice AI agents
items.excerpt: Innovaccer is adding xAI's Grok Voice to its Gravity Voice AI agents for autonomous patient engagement calls (vendor upgrade; check for measured outcomes).

items.title: The Future of AI in Nursing Must Begin with the Outcomes We Intend to Achieve
items.excerpt: Opinion: for nursing, AI's value lies in whether it contributes to defined clinical and workforce outcomes rather than adoption for its own sake (opinion - low priority).
